_about: GEN18 — ноутбук 47 (WEB-C): фото граней строго по раскладке модели (первый референс — ортовид модели из laptop47.js) и бесшовные макро-фактуры для карт roughness/bump/normal/displacement. Запуск: design/tools/kie/kie_batch.ps1 (ветка claude/kie-batch). Автор 26.11: «можешь генерировать все необходимые текстуры». Наклейки HEXON здесь нет — она кладётся своим файлом. Паспорт износа общий, без примет.

jobs.label: T1_deck
jobs.prompt: T1 (file label, not part of the image, never draw it). Turn the first image, a computer layout render, into a real photograph. Perfectly straight top-down orthographic photograph of the keyboard deck of a generic black business laptop from 2009, with exactly the same framing as the first image: the base fills the frame and the same plain flat medium grey background surrounds it. Keep exactly the outline, the rounded corners, and the position, size and shape of every part from the first image: every key of the keyboard in the same place, the speaker grille strip above the keyboard, the round power button, the three tiny indicator lights, the two hinges at the top edge, the touchpad and its two buttons. Do not add, move or remove any part. All keycaps completely blank: no letters, numbers or symbols on any key. Materials like the other reference photographs: matte charcoal plastic with a fine even sand-blasted grain, black keycaps with a slightly smoother matte finish, thin dark gaps between keys. Used every day for about a year: the palm rest left and right of the touchpad worn smooth to a soft satin sheen in two oval areas, the space bar and the most used keys slightly shiny, the touchpad polished in its centre, edges and corners slightly rubbed lighter, fine grey dust and a few lint fibres in the key gaps, along the seams and around the hinges. No other marks: no scratches, cracks, dents, stains, stickers. Lit with soft completely even shadowless photo-tent light: no highlights, no reflections, no gradient, no vignetting. Natural colours, everything sharp. No text, no logo, no people.
